(Guizhou Province Guiyang No. 1 High School 2016 senior three prediction secret paper (New Curriculum Standard II paper) science comprehensive physics test question) As shown in the figure, A and B are the metal plates of a parallel-plate capacitor, and G is an electrometer. At the beginning, switch S is closed, and the pointer of the electrometer opens by a certain angle. Which of the following operations can make the opening angle of the pointer increase somewhat? (  )
A. Keep switch S closed, and move the slider on R to the right
B. After disconnecting switch S, separate the two plates A and B somewhat
C. After disconnecting switch S, reduce the facing area of the two plates A and B somewhat
D. Keep switch S closed, and separate the two plates A and B somewhat

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure it can be seen that A and B are a pair of parallel metal plates on the right side, forming a parallel-plate capacitor; below there is an electrometer G connected to the capacitor, used to reflect the magnitude of the potential difference between the two plates; in the circuit on the left there is a power supply, switch S, and sliding rheostat R, and when switch S is closed, the capacitor is connected into this external circuit. Then reason: The opening angle of the electrometer pointer increases as the voltage U between the two plates of the capacitor increases. If S is kept closed, the capacitor is connected to the power supply, and after stabilization the voltage between the two plates is maintained by the power supply; the electrometer approximately draws no current, and moving the slider of R only affects the charging process or the resistance magnitude, and cannot make the stable voltage increase, so A is not selected; when S is kept closed and the plates A and B are separated, the power supply still maintains the voltage between the two plates unchanged, only the capacitance and the amount of charge change, and the opening angle does not increase, so D is not selected. If S is disconnected, the capacitor is isolated from the power supply, and the charge Q it carries remains unchanged. The parallel-plate capacitance C=εS/d, and the voltage between the two plates U=Q/C. After S is disconnected, increasing the plate spacing d will make C decrease and U increase, and the electrometer opening angle increase, so B is selected; after S is disconnected, reducing the facing area S will also make C decrease and U increase, and the electrometer opening angle increase, so C is selected.

As shown in the figure, A and B are the metal plates of a parallel-plate capacitor, and G is an electrometer. At the beginning, switch S is closed, and the pointer of the electrometer opens by a certain angle. Which of the following operations can make the opening angle of the pointer increase somewhat? ( )
A. Keep switch S closed, and move the slider on R to the right
B. After disconnecting switch S, separate the two plates A and B somewhat
C. After disconnecting switch S, reduce the facing area of the two plates A and B somewhat
D. Keep switch S closed, and separate the two plates A and B somewhat

method.method_draft: 先读图：图中A、B是平行板电容器两板，静电计G与电容器相连，用来显示两板间电势差；开关S闭合时，电容器接在含电源和变阻器R的外电路上。再读题文各选项，分别区分“保持S闭合”和“断开S后”两类情况。判据是静电计张角随电容器两板电压U增大而增大。S闭合时，电容器由电源维持电压，静电计近似不取电流，移动R滑片或改变板距只改变充电过程/电容，不会使稳定电压增大，所以A、D不选。S断开后，电容器与电源隔离，所带电荷Q保持不变；平行板电容C=εS/d，两板电压U=Q/C。将两极板分开使d增大、C减小、U增大，故B选；减小正对面积使S减小、C减小、U增大，故C选。最终得到BC。

再推理：静电计指针张角随电容器两板间电压U增大而增大。若保持S闭合，电容器与电源相连，稳定后两板间电压由电源维持，静电计近似不取电流，移动R的滑片只影响充电过程或电阻大小，不能使稳定电压增大，所以A不选；保持S闭合时把A、B板分开，电源仍维持两板间电压不变，只是电容和电荷量改变，张角不增大，所以D不选。若断开S，电容器与电源隔离，所带电荷Q保持不变。平行板电容C=εS/d，两板电压U=Q/C。断开S后增大板间距d，会使C减小、U增大，静电计张角增大，所以B选；断开S后减小正对面积S，也会使C减小、U增大，静电计张角增大，所以C选。
